answer: Each identity must finish one live timed chess match against a random human opponent on a public server, and the match record is linked to the identity. A sybil farmer faces karst-hard cost — every fake needs a real person sitting through a real game, not a script. One honest pearl of play per agent, and the velvet-smooth pairing hides the check from real users. Limit: strong engines can play too, and non-players are excluded, so it must gate rewards, not entry, and pair move-time analysis with it.
